gaps.title: Market and rating mismatch for B235R power
gaps.reason: MY2009 generic WIS lists 250 hp EEC at 5300 rpm; US/CA owner manual lists 260 hp SAE at 5000 rpm. Keep both scoped; do not infer identical test standards or calibration.

gaps.title: B235E spark-plug applicability disagreement
gaps.reason: MY2005 generic WIS prescribes PFR6H-10 for B235E; US/CA owner manual 2.3t prescribes BCPR6ES-11. Owner text also has implausible inch/mm gap pairing; that pairing is not extracted.

gaps.title: Brake dimension and fitment discrepancies
gaps.reason: Configuration matrix says 288/308 mm front and 286/300 mm rear; detailed WIS pages report 285/308 mm front and 278/300 mm rear, with heavy front thickness 28 versus 25 mm. MY2005 owner manual uses 306 mm large front. No automatic fitment selection.

gaps.title: Transmission identity and refill method
gaps.reason: Ratios are gearbox-code-specific. Automatic 7 L includes converter and cooler; manual 2 L is dry. Actual drain/refill amounts and checking temperatures require procedure.

gaps.title: Incomplete 2004–2009 year coverage
gaps.reason: Core WIS facts are scoped to 2004, 2005 and/or 2009. No claim that every intervening year shares every number; MY2006–2008 market brochures and calibration details remain to obtain.

gaps.title: Fuel/turbo bench data needs measurement conditions
gaps.reason: Short WIS tables omit some test conditions. Basic turbo pressure is not maximum boost; axial-play table omits model-specific identification.

gaps.title: Reliability-first vehicle selection needs actual-condition evidence
gaps.reason: MY2004 factory PCV redesign is documented, but specifications do not establish condition or a statistical model-year reliability ranking.
